subject: ONE barrel sponge creature, porous orange body, stubby arms, one big round eye, covering ground in every beat, never planted
second_characters: ONE crab trader hurling goods off his counter, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp whipping across the lens; from 6.10 TWO huge hands wringing him

props.big: ONE upright vacuum, hose lashing the full frame width, only hauled and swung, never worked in place
props.small: A SWARM of small goods and broken parts hurtling past the lens

environment: an underwater market row of loaded counters, kelp and crates top and bottom, shoals blowing through
lighting: bright daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his eye never under a quarter of it. The world flies at him: goods, crates and the second characters tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, a new shot size each beat, medium to close. He drives across the frame in EVERY beat and the camera races level with him, the counters streaking behind, never parked. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word ноль done by 6.10, then water and parts carry it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ko-she-LYOK, GUB-ka, vpi-TY-va-et, pod-RYAD, vy-da-YOT, NOL

timeline.a: already diving off a tilting stack of crates, hauling the vacuum the full frame width down the counter row; goods blast off the counters past the lens
he swings the hose overhead through the flying goods and drives on, the shrimp whipping across the lens
he whips the hose the full frame width and a whole counter of goods tears into his pores, his body swelling to twice its width; the crab flings more past his eye
swollen huge, he hauls the vacuum under his eye while driving on, the crab dragging his other arm back
he flips upside down the full frame width over a bare counter and shakes himself, ONE bubble leaving his pores
TWO huge hands reach in and wring him double, dirty water bursting from his pores the full frame width
they wring harder and broken parts shoot out of him past the lens, the crab reeling back through the spray
they fling his wrung body across the frame, parts still raining
he drives back the full frame width and swallows a fresh crate, swelling again
the hands wring him once more, ONE bent spring shooting past the lens
he shakes the limp hose over his eye as he drives past the lens, one bubble leaving it

must_appear: the hero fills half the frame height start to end; at 0.00 mid dive off the crates; at 2.10 goods pouring off the counter into his pores; at 6.10 two hands wringing him, dirty water bursting out; at 6.90 parts flying out of him
